card.name: Storage temperature start and dialect g-dropping
card.fires_on: The digit 2 that begins a storage temperature such as 2°C to 8°C, and apostrophes or letters in dropped-g dialect words like draggin' and Braggin'.

modes.label: Storage temperature
modes.description: The first digit of a refrigerated or room-temperature range after 'stored at'.

modes.label: Dialect spelling
modes.description: The apostrophe or ending of dropped-g and clipped words in quoted speech or titles.
modes.example: an' draggin<<'>> him with his shy ways into

card.writes: Little clear effect; it suppresses apostrophe tokens and promotes assorted word-ending pieces.
card.plain: It fires on the first digit of a storage temperature like 2°C to 8°C, and on apostrophes in dropped-g dialect words.
